## Objetivo
Build the pure suggestion engine, authenticated confirmed-night suggestions endpoint and responsive suggestion cards. Define a repository interface supplying prior-night game IDs; until T14 connects persisted history from T05's play storage, production history is empty, not fabricated. Unit-test exclusion with seeded repository input. T14 connects persisted plays and supplies cross-feature integration tests.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Seeded unit tests cover inclusive min/max players and exact time fit, games too short on capacity or too long in duration, zero attendees, no eligible games and stable duration/title/ID sorting. Explanations name attendee count, available minutes and recent-night eligibility without implying that excluded games are eligible.
- [ ] A tested selector chooses the last two distinct confirmed nights strictly before the target by slot time then ID, not the last two plays; multiple plays in a night, one/no prior night, unplayed nights, ad hoc plays and later nights have explicit fixtures. Games played in those selected nights are excluded. Production service accepts repository history input through a concrete typed adapter, completed in T14.
- [ ] API tests check signed-out access, unknown or unconfirmed night and that the attendee snapshot and chosen duration drive suggestions. Browser tests at both viewports display eligible cards and explanation text, and show a crafted empty state with a next step, capturing each after scrolling relevant content into view. npm test, typecheck and build remain green.
